# judo-requirement-report

> A Java compile-time annotation processor that extracts requirement and test-case metadata from annotated test methods and generates CSV traceability reports.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven 3.9.4 multi-module project (3 modules)
- Provides `@Requirement` and `@TestCase` annotations with SOURCE retention (zero runtime footprint)
- Generates semicolon-separated CSV reports (`requirements-report.csv`, `testcases-report.csv`) during compilation
- Uses Google Auto Service for processor registration, OpenCSV for CSV generation
- Part of the [judo-community](https://github.com/BlackBeltTechnology/judo-community) ecosystem
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, module structure, quick start, and usage examples
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide with build commands, directory structure, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup and contribution guidelines
- [.github/CIFLOW.md](.github/CIFLOW.md): Detailed CI/CD workflow with Mermaid diagrams

## Modules

- [judo-requirement-report-annotation/pom.xml](judo-requirement-report-annotation/pom.xml): Defines `@Requirement` and `@TestCase` annotations with SOURCE retention
- [judo-requirement-report-processor/pom.xml](judo-requirement-report-processor/pom.xml): Annotation processor that discovers, validates, and generates CSV traceability reports at compile time
- [judo-requirement-report-test/pom.xml](judo-requirement-report-test/pom.xml): End-to-end tests — annotated methods serve as processor input, JUnit tests verify CSV output

## Optional

- [.github/workflows/build.yml](.github/workflows/build.yml): CI/CD build pipeline (GitHub Actions)
- [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt): Eclipse Public License 2.0 license text
- [pom.xml](pom.xml): Parent POM with shared dependencies, plugin management, and profiles
